pt.B: Os filhos de Judá: Perez, Hezrom, Carmi, Hur e Sobal.
pt.R: Entre os descendentes de Judá estavam Perez, Hezrom, Carmi, Hur e Sobal.

decisions.choice: sons: descendants in a line, one generation after another
decisions.reason: These five are not brothers. Perez was Judah's son (Genesis 38:29), Hezron was Perez's son (Genesis 46:12), Hur was a grandson of Hezron through Caleb (2:18-19), and Shobal was Hur's son (2:50). "Sons" here means descendants, and the list traces one line down from Judah, picking up the family of 2:50-55.

decisions.choice: Carmi: a name standing where Caleb (Chelubai) is expected
decisions.reason: In 2:7 Carmi belongs to the line of Zerah, not Perez (compare Joshua 7:1). In this line the son of Hezron should be Caleb, also spelled Chelubai (2:9, 18). The name may have been changed in copying, or another Carmi may be meant; the text gives no more information.

decisions.choice: the chapter resumes the clans of Judah from chapter 2
decisions.reason: Chapters 2 and 4 together give the families of Judah, the tribe of David. This chapter adds short notes on clans and the towns they settled in the south, many of them not mentioned anywhere else.

decisions.choice: descendants included
decisions.reason: Readable says "descendants" because the five names are successive generations, not brothers (see the meaning note).

decisions.choice: "Entre los descendientes de Judá estaban"
decisions.reason: The five names are successive generations, not brothers (m1), so Readable says "descendientes", as the English says "descendants included".

decisions.choice: "자손 가운데는 ...이 있었다"
decisions.reason: The five names are generations one after another, not brothers; Readable says "descendants", as the English does.

decisions.choice: Os filhos de X: (L, B), Os filhos de X foram (R); gerou (L), foi o pai de (B, R); the name forms of Genesis 38 and 46, Numbers 26 and Ruth 4
decisions.reason: The genealogy formulas set in 1:5 and 1:10 are kept unchanged. The names keep the forms already set: Perez, Hezrom and Carmi as Genesis 46:9-12, Hur as Exodus 17:10, Sobal as Genesis 36:20. Readable says "Entre os descendentes ... estavam", since the five are generations, not brothers (m1).

decisions.choice: rare names spelled by the patterns of Genesis 46
decisions.reason: For this chapter: names found nowhere else in the drafted books are spelled by the patterns Genesis 46:9 sets for Portuguese ("qu" for the k-sound, a final -e after a consonant Portuguese cannot end on, -om for -on, -ã for -an, -ias for -iah, an unsounded h dropped): Aumai, Laade, Hazelelponi, Auzão, Haastari, Quelube, Estom, Teína, Ir-Naás, Meonotai, Ge-Harasim, Jealelel, Jecutiel, Bitia, Zoete, Bete-Asbeia, Jasubi-Leém, Netaim and the like. Better-known names keep their usual forms (Tecoa, Efrata, Belém, Queila, Maressa, Gedera, Socó, Zanoa, Estemoa, Zife, as Joshua 15 and 2 Samuel). A reviewer should confirm the rarer forms.

records.literal_gloss: And Reaiah son of Shobal begot Jahath, and Jahath begot Ahumai and Lahad; these [were the] clans of the Zorathite[s].

en.L: And Reaiah son of Shobal begot Jahath, and Jahath begot Ahumai and Lahad. These [were the] clans of the Zorathites.
en.B: Reaiah son of Shobal was the father of Jahath, and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
en.R: Shobal's son Reaiah was the father of Jahath. Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the people of Zorah.

es.L: Y Reaía hijo de Sobal engendró a Jahat, y Jahat engendró a Ahumai y a Lahad. Estos [fueron los] clanes de los zoratitas.
es.B: Reaía hijo de Sobal fue padre de Jahat, y Jahat fue padre de Ahumai y de Lahad. Estos fueron los clanes de los zoratitas.
es.R: Reaía, hijo de Sobal, fue padre de Jahat. Jahat fue padre de Ahumai y de Lahad. Estos fueron los clanes de la gente de Zora.

fr.L: Et Reaya, fils de Shobal, engendra Yahath, et Yahath engendra Ahoumaï et Lahad. Ce [sont] les clans des Tsoreatites.
fr.B: Reaya, fils de Shobal, fut le père de Yahath, et Yahath fut le père d’Ahoumaï et de Lahad. Ce sont les clans des Tsoreatites.
fr.R: Reaya, le fils de Shobal, a eu pour fils Yahath. Yahath a eu pour fils Ahoumaï et Lahad. Ce sont les clans des gens de Tsorea.

sw.L: Na Reaya mwana wa Shobali alimzaa Yahathi, na Yahathi alimzaa Ahumai na Lahadi. Hizi [zilikuwa] koo za Wasorathi.
sw.B: Reaya mwana wa Shobali alikuwa baba wa Yahathi, na Yahathi alikuwa baba wa Ahumai na Lahadi. Hizo ndizo zilizokuwa koo za Wasorathi.
sw.R: Reaya mwana wa Shobali alikuwa baba wa Yahathi. Yahathi alikuwa baba wa Ahumai na Lahadi. Hizo ndizo zilizokuwa koo za watu wa Sora.

vi.L: Và Rê-a-gia con trai Sô-banh sinh Gia-hát, và Gia-hát sinh A-hu-mai và La-hát. Đó [là] các họ hàng của người Xô-ra-tít.

vi.R: Rê-a-gia, con trai của Sô-banh, là cha của Gia-hát. Gia-hát là cha của A-hu-mai và La-hát. Đó là các gia tộc của dân thành Xô-ra.

ko.L: 그리고 소발의 아들 르아야는 야핫을 낳고, 야핫은 아후매와 라핫을 낳았다. 이들이 소라 사람의 씨족들이다.
ko.B: 소발의 아들 르아야는 야핫을 낳고, 야핫은 아후매와 라핫을 낳았다. 이들이 소라 사람의 씨족들이었다.
ko.R: 소발의 아들 르아야는 야핫을 낳았다. 야핫은 아후매와 라핫을 낳았다. 이들이 소라에 사는 사람들의 씨족들이었다.

pt.L: E Reaías, filho de Sobal, gerou Jaate, e Jaate gerou Aumai e Laade. Estes [eram] os clãs dos zoratitas.
pt.B: Reaías, filho de Sobal, foi o pai de Jaate, e Jaate foi o pai de Aumai e Laade. Esses foram os clãs dos zoratitas.
pt.R: Reaías, filho de Sobal, foi o pai de Jaate. Jaate foi o pai de Aumai e Laade. Esses foram os clãs do povo de Zorá.

decisions.choice: Reaiah: probably the same man as Haroeh son of Shobal in 2:52
decisions.reason: In 2:52 Shobal's son is called Haroeh, a name very close in spelling to Reaiah; the two lists seem to describe the same family.

decisions.choice: the Zorathites: the people of Zorah
decisions.reason: Zorah was a town in the low hills west of Jerusalem (Joshua 15:33), the home of Samson's family (Judges 13:2). In 2:53 the Zorathites are counted among Shobal's descendants.

decisions.choice: the people of Zorah
decisions.reason: Readable names the town instead of using the clan name "Zorathites".

decisions.choice: os zoratitas (L, B); o povo de Zorá (R)
decisions.reason: The clan name is formed on "Zorá", the town as Joshua 15:33 and Judges 13:2 spell it in Portuguese, with the "-itas" of the clan names in Numbers 26. Readable names the town, as the English Readable does.

records.literal_gloss: And these [were the] father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and [the] name of their sister [was] Hazzelelponi.

en.L: And these [were of the] father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and [the] name of their sister [was] Hazzelelponi.
en.B: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma and Idbash. Their sister was named Hazzelelponi.
en.R: These were the sons of the founder of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma and Idbash. They had a sister named Hazzelelponi.

es.B: Estos fueron los hijos del padre de Etam: Jezreel, Isma e Idbas. Su hermana se llamaba Hazelelponi.
es.R: Estos fueron los hijos del fundador de Etam: Jezreel, Isma e Idbas. Tenían una hermana llamada Hazelelponi.

fr.L: Et ceux-ci [étaient du] père d’Étam : Jizreël, et Yishma, et Yidbash ; et le nom de leur sœur [était] Hatslelponi.
fr.B: Voici les fils du père d’Étam : Jizreël, Yishma et Yidbash. Leur sœur s’appelait Hatslelponi.
fr.R: Voici les fils du fondateur d’Étam : Jizreël, Yishma et Yidbash. Ils avaient une sœur, qui s’appelait Hatslelponi.

sw.L: Na hawa [walikuwa wa] baba wa Etamu: Yezreeli, na Ishma, na Idbashi; na jina la dada yao [lilikuwa] Haselelponi.
sw.B: Hawa walikuwa wana wa baba wa Etamu: Yezreeli, Ishma na Idbashi. Dada yao aliitwa Haselelponi.
sw.R: Hawa walikuwa wana wa mwanzilishi wa Etamu: Yezreeli, Ishma na Idbashi. Walikuwa na dada aitwaye Haselelponi.

vi.B: Đây là các con trai của cha của Ê-tam: Gít-rê-ên, Dít-ma và Di-ba. Em gái của họ tên là Ha-xê-lên-phô-ni.
vi.R: Đây là các con trai của người lập ra thành Ê-tam: Gít-rê-ên, Dít-ma và Di-ba. Họ có một em gái tên là Ha-xê-lên-phô-ni.

ko.L: 그리고 이들은 에담의 아버지[의 아들들]이다. 이스르엘과 이스마와 잇바스. 그리고 그들의 누이의 이름은 하술렐보니이다.
ko.B: 에담의 아버지의 아들들은 이스르엘과 이스마와 잇바스였다. 그들의 누이의 이름은 하술렐보니였다.
ko.R: 에담을 세운 사람의 아들들은 이스르엘, 이스마, 잇바스였다. 그들에게는 하술렐보니라는 누이가 있었다.

pt.L: E estes [eram os filhos do] pai de Etã: Jezreel, e Isma, e Idbás; e o nome da irmã deles [era] Hazelelponi.
pt.B: Estes foram os filhos do pai de Etã: Jezreel, Isma e Idbás. A irmã deles se chamava Hazelelponi.
pt.R: Estes foram os filhos do fundador de Etã: Jezreel, Isma e Idbás. Eles tinham uma irmã chamada Hazelelponi.

decisions.choice: these were the sons of the father of Etam
alternatives: these were the father of Etam (as the Hebrew stands)
these are the sons of Etam
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads only "these [were] the father of Etam", which does not fit the list of three names that follows. The ancient Greek translation reads "these are the sons of Etam". A word meaning "sons" seems to have dropped out in copying, and the list is read as the sons of Etam's founder.

decisions.choice: father of a town: its founder, or the head of the clan that settled it
alternatives: the father of a son with that name
decisions.reason: As at 2:24: "father" of a town means its founder, or the ancestor of the clan that lived there. The title comes many times in this chapter (verses 4, 5, 12, 17, 18, 19, 21).

decisions.choice: Etam and Jezreel: places of Judah's hill country
decisions.reason: This Etam was a town near Bethlehem, later fortified by Rehoboam (2 Chronicles 11:6); a different Etam belonged to Simeon (verse 32). Jezreel here is a clan named like the town of Judah (Joshua 15:56), not the northern valley. A daughter is named in the list, as in 2:16 and 3:9.

decisions.choice: the sons of
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply "the sons of" so the sentence makes sense (see the text note). Literal brackets the supplied words.

decisions.choice: the founder of
decisions.reason: Readable says "founder of" where "father of" is followed by a town, as at 2:24. Literal and Balanced keep "father of".

decisions.choice: "[los hijos del] padre de Etam" (L); "los hijos del padre de Etam" (B); "los hijos del fundador de Etam" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads only "these, the father of Etam" (m1); Spanish, like the English, supplies "los hijos de", in brackets at Literal.

decisions.choice: mwanzilishi wa
decisions.reason: As at 2:24, Readable says "mwanzilishi wa" (founder of) where "father of" is followed by a town; Literal and Balanced keep "baba wa".

decisions.choice: "em gái" for the one daughter named after her brothers
decisions.reason: Vietnamese names a sister as older or younger; a daughter named after her brothers is taken as the younger, as with Tamar (3:9).

decisions.choice: pai (L, B); fundador (R)
decisions.reason: For the chapter: where "father of" is followed by a town (m2), Literal and Balanced keep "pai de" and Readable says "fundador de", as the English does with "founder". "Etã" is the form of Judges 15:8 in Portuguese.

source.text: וּפְנוּאֵל֙ אֲבִ֣י גְדֹ֔ר וְעֵ֖זֶר אֲבִ֣י חוּשָׁ֑ה אֵ֤לֶּה בְנֵי־חוּר֙ בְּכ֣וֹר אֶפְרָ֔תָה אֲבִ֖י בֵּ֥ית לָֽחֶם׃

records.literal_gloss: And Penuel [the] father of Gedor, and Ezer [the] father of Hushah; these [were the] sons of Hur, [the] firstborn of Ephrathah, [the] father of Bethlehem.

en.L: And Penuel [was the] father of Gedor, and Ezer [the] father of Hushah. These [were the] sons of Hur, [the] firstborn of Ephrathah, [the] father of Bethlehem.
en.B: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah and the father of Bethlehem.
en.R: Penuel was the founder of Gedor, and Ezer was the founder of Hushah. These were the descendants of Hur. Hur was the oldest son of Ephrathah, and he was the founder of Bethlehem.

es.L: Y Penuel [fue el] padre de Gedor, y Ezer [el] padre de Husa. Estos [fueron los] hijos de Hur, [el] primogénito de Efrata, [el] padre de Belén.
es.B: Penuel fue padre de Gedor, y Ezer, padre de Husa. Estos fueron los hijos de Hur, el primogénito de Efrata y padre de Belén.
es.R: Penuel fue el fundador de Gedor, y Ezer fue el fundador de Husa. Estos fueron los descendientes de Hur. Hur era el hijo mayor de Efrata, y fue el fundador de Belén.

fr.L: Et Penouel [était le] père de Guedor, et Ézer, père de Housha. Ce [sont] les fils de Hour, premier-né d’Éphrata, père de Bethléem.
fr.B: Penouel était le père de Guedor, et Ézer le père de Housha. Ce sont les fils de Hour, premier-né d’Éphrata et père de Bethléem.
fr.R: Penouel a été le fondateur de Guedor, et Ézer le fondateur de Housha. C’étaient des descendants de Hour. Hour était le fils aîné d’Éphrata, et il a été le fondateur de Bethléem.

sw.L: Na Penueli [alikuwa] baba wa Gedori, na Ezeri baba wa Husha. Hawa [walikuwa] wana wa Huri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Efrata, baba wa Bethlehemu.
sw.B: Penueli alikuwa baba wa Gedori, na Ezeri baba wa Husha. Hao ndio waliokuwa wana wa Huri, mzaliwa wa kwanza wa Efrata na baba wa Bethlehemu.
sw.R: Penueli alikuwa mwanzilishi wa Gedori, na Ezeri alikuwa mwanzilishi wa Husha. Hao ndio waliokuwa wazao wa Huri. Huri alikuwa mwana mkubwa wa Efrata, naye alikuwa mwanzilishi wa Bethlehemu.

vi.L: Và Phê-nu-ên [là] cha của Ghê-đô, và Ê-xe [là] cha của Hu-sa. Đó [là] các con trai của Hu-rơ, con đầu lòng của Ép-ra-ta, cha của Bết-lê-hem.
vi.B: Phê-nu-ên là cha của Ghê-đô, và Ê-xe là cha của Hu-sa. Đó là các con trai của Hu-rơ, con đầu lòng của Ép-ra-ta và là cha của Bết-lê-hem.
vi.R: Phê-nu-ên là người lập ra thành Ghê-đô, và Ê-xe là người lập ra thành Hu-sa. Đó là con cháu của Hu-rơ. Hu-rơ là con trai cả của Ép-ra-ta, và ông là người lập ra thành Bết-lê-hem.

ko.L: 그리고 브누엘은 그돌의 아버지이고, 에셀은 후사의 아버지이다. 이들이 베들레헴의 아버지, 곧 에브라다의 맏아들 훌의 아들들이다.
ko.B: 브누엘은 그돌의 아버지였고, 에셀은 후사의 아버지였다. 이들은 에브라다의 맏아들이며 베들레헴의 아버지인 훌의 아들들이었다.
ko.R: 브누엘은 그돌을 세웠고, 에셀은 후사를 세웠다. 이들은 훌의 자손이었다. 훌은 에브라다의 맏아들이었고, 베들레헴을 세운 사람이었다.

pt.L: E Penuel [era o] pai de Gedor, e Ézer, [o] pai de Husá. Estes [eram os] filhos de Hur, [o] primogênito de Efrata, [o] pai de Belém.
pt.B: Penuel foi o pai de Gedor, e Ézer, o pai de Husá. Esses foram os filhos de Hur, o primogênito de Efrata e pai de Belém.
pt.R: Penuel foi o fundador de Gedor, e Ézer foi o fundador de Husá. Esses foram os descendentes de Hur. Hur era o filho mais velho de Efrata e foi o fundador de Belém.

decisions.choice: Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Caleb's eldest son by his wife Ephrathah
decisions.reason: Ephrathah was the wife of Caleb son of Hezron, and Hur was her first son (2:19, 50). Ephrathah is also an old name for Bethlehem and its district (Genesis 35:19; Ruth 4:11; Micah 5:1), so the clan and its town share the name.

decisions.choice: father of Bethlehem: founder of the town
decisions.reason: In 2:51 Hur's son Salma is called the father of Bethlehem. Here the title is given to Hur, the head of the whole clan; the two notes fit together if the town was founded by Hur's family. "Father of" a town is explained at verse 3.

decisions.choice: Gedor and Hushah: towns of Judah's hill country
decisions.reason: Gedor is listed in Joshua 15:58. Hushah was the home of Sibbecai the Hushathite, one of David's warriors (2 Samuel 21:18).

decisions.choice: founder; oldest son
decisions.reason: Readable says "founder" for "father of" a town, as at verse 3, and "oldest son" for "firstborn".

decisions.choice: Gedor, Husá, Efrata, Belém
decisions.reason: Gedor keeps the form of Joshua 15:58, Efrata and Belém the forms of Genesis 35:19. Hushah is "Husá", the town from which 2 Samuel 21:18 calls Sibbecai "o husatita".

source.text: וּלְאַשְׁחוּר֙ אֲבִ֣י תְק֔וֹעַ הָי֖וּ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֑ים חֶלְאָ֖ה וְנַעֲרָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And to Ashhur [the] father of Tekoa were two wives, Helah and Naarah.

decisions.choice: Ashhur: the son of Hezron born after his father's death
decisions.reason: According to 2:24, Ashhur was born to Hezron's wife Abijah after Hezron died, and he is there also called the father of Tekoa.

decisions.choice: Tekoa: a town south of Bethlehem
decisions.reason: Tekoa stood on the edge of the wilderness of Judah. It was the home of the wise woman sent to David (2 Samuel 14:2) and of the prophet Amos (Amos 1:1).

decisions.choice: Koz: a new name with no link given to the names before

en.B: Jabez was held in greater honor than his brothers. His mother gave him the name Jabez, for she said, "I bore him in pain."
en.R: Jabez was more respected than his brothers. When he was born, his mother called him Jabez. She said, "His birth was very painful for me."

ko.L: 그리고 야베스는 그의 형제들보다 더 존귀했다. 그리고 그의 어머니가 그의 이름을 야베스라고 부르며 말했다. "내가 고통 속에서 [그를] 낳았기 때문이다."
ko.B: 야베스는 그의 형제들보다 더 존경받는 사람이었다. 그의 어머니는 "내가 고통 속에서 그를 낳았다" 하면서 그의 이름을 야베스라고 지었다.
ko.R: 야베스는 그의 형제들보다 더 존경을 받았다. 그가 태어났을 때 그의 어머니는 그를 야베스라고 불렀다. 그녀는 "이 아이를 낳을 때 몹시 아팠다" 하고 말했다.

pt.L: E Jabez foi mais honrado do que os seus irmãos, e a sua mãe chamou o seu nome Jabez, dizendo: "Porque [o] dei à luz com dor."
pt.B: Jabez era mais respeitado do que os seus irmãos. A mãe lhe deu o nome de Jabez, pois disse: "Eu o dei à luz com dor."
pt.R: Jabez era mais respeitado do que os seus irmãos. Quando ele nasceu, a mãe lhe deu o nome de Jabez. Ela disse: "O parto dele me causou muita dor."

decisions.choice: Jabez ... in pain: a play on the name
decisions.reason: The name Jabez (ya'bets) sounds like the word for "pain" ('otsev) with two of its letters in reverse order. His mother named him after the pain of his birth, much as Rachel named her dying child Ben-oni, "son of my sorrow" (Genesis 35:18); the same word family is used of the pain of childbirth in Genesis 3:16. A name like this seemed to set a mark on a life, which is why Jabez prays as he does in verse 10.

decisions.choice: more honored: of greater standing and respect
decisions.reason: The word describes a man held in esteem. The writer does not say why; his prayer in the next verse is the only thing told about him. A place called Jabez is named in 2:55, where families of scribes lived, but its link with this man is not stated.

decisions.choice: his mother called: an earlier event told as background
decisions.reason: The naming took place at his birth, long before the prayer; the clause gives the background to it.

decisions.choice: held in greater honor; His birth was very painful for me
decisions.reason: Balanced says "held in greater honor" to keep the sense of standing. Readable says "respected" and puts the mother's words in plain modern form.

decisions.choice: "Jabes" ... "con dolor"
decisions.reason: The name sounds like the Hebrew word for "pain" (m1); Spanish cannot keep the play, which the meaning decision explains, and keeps "dolor" here and in the prayer of verse 10 so the echo is still heard.

decisions.choice: the plus-que-parfait "lui avait donné" for the naming
decisions.reason: The naming happened before the time of the first clause (m3); French marks the earlier event with the plus-que-parfait.

decisions.choice: uchungu (pain)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew plays on Jabez and the word for pain; Swahili cannot keep the sound play, so the meaning note carries it. "Uchungu" is the word for the pains of childbirth.

decisions.choice: the name kept, the sound play left to the meaning note
decisions.reason: The name Jabez sounds like the Hebrew word for "pain"; Vietnamese cannot copy the sound, so every level keeps the name and the mother's words, as the English does, and the meaning decision explains the play.

decisions.choice: "고통" for the pain the name echoes
decisions.reason: The name Jabez sounds like the Hebrew word for pain (m1); Korean keeps the name and says the pain plainly ("고통", Readable "아팠다"), and the prayer of verse 10 echoes it with "고통" and "아프게".

decisions.choice: Jabez; com dor (L, B); me causou muita dor (R)
alternatives: Jabez, que lembra a palavra "dor" (in the text)
decisions.reason: The name keeps the form Brazilian readers know, "Jabez". In Hebrew it sounds like the word for "pain" with two letters turned round (m1); no Portuguese word sounds like it, so the play cannot be heard, and, as in the English, no level explains it in the text: the meaning note does. Every level keeps the word "dor", which comes back in Jabez's prayer in verse 10 ("para que não me cause dor"), so that the reader can see the link the two verses make (verse 10, m4).

decisions.choice: era mais respeitado
decisions.reason: Balanced says "respeitado", the word for a man held in esteem by others (m2); "honrado" in Brazilian Portuguese now suggests honesty more than standing. Literal keeps "honrado".

source.text: וַיִּקְרָ֣א יַ֠עְבֵּץ לֵאלֹהֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל לֵאמֹ֗ר אִם־בָּרֵ֨ךְ תְּבָרֲכֵ֜נִי וְהִרְבִּ֤יתָ אֶת־גְּבוּלִי֙ וְהָיְתָ֤ה יָדְךָ֙ עִמִּ֔י וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מֵּרָעָ֖ה לְבִלְתִּ֣י עָצְבִּ֑י וַיָּבֵ֥א אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־שָׁאָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And called Jabez to [the] God of Israel, saying, If blessing you will bless me, and you will increase my border, and will be your hand with me, and you will make [me] from harm not to pain me; and brought God what he asked.

en.L: And Jabez called to [the] God of Israel, saying, "If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will indeed bless me, and increase my border, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand will be with me, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will keep [me] from harm, so that it might not pain me!" And God brought about what he had asked.
en.B: Jabez called on the God of Israel: "If only {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} would bless me richly and enlarge my border! If only {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand would be with me, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} would keep me from harm, so that it might not pain me!" And God gave him what he had asked.
en.R: Jabez prayed to the God of Israel. He said, "Please bless me greatly and give me more land. Be with me and help me. Keep me safe from harm, so that it will not cause me pain." And God gave him what he asked for.

es.L: Y Jabes invocó al Dios de Israel, diciendo: «¡Si de verdad me bendijeras, y ensancharas mi territorio, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano estuviera conmigo, y me guardaras del mal, para que no me causara dolor!». Y Dios hizo venir lo que había pedido.
es.B: Jabes invocó al Dios de Israel: «¡Ojalá me bendijeras abundantemente y ensancharas mi territorio! ¡Ojalá {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mano estuviera conmigo y me guardaras del mal, para que no me causara dolor!». Y Dios le concedió lo que había pedido.
es.R: Jabes oró al Dios de Israel. Le dijo: «Por favor, bendíceme mucho y dame más tierra. Acompáñame y ayúdame. Protégeme del mal, para que no sufra dolor». Y Dios le concedió lo que pidió.

fr.L: Et Yabets invoqua le Dieu d’Israël, disant : « Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me bénis vraiment, et agrandis mon territoire, et [si] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main est avec moi, et [si] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me gardes du malheur, pour qu’il ne me fasse pas souffrir ! » Et Dieu fit venir ce qu’il avait demandé.
fr.B: Yabets invoqua le Dieu d’Israël : « Si seulement {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me bénissais largement et agrandissais mon territoire ! Si seulement {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} main était avec moi, et si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me gardais du malheur, pour qu’il ne me fasse pas souffrir ! » Et Dieu lui accorda ce qu’il avait demandé.
fr.R: Yabets a prié le Dieu d’Israël. Il a dit : « Bénis-moi beaucoup, s’il te plaît, et donne-moi plus de terres. Sois avec moi et aide-moi. Protège-moi du malheur, pour que je ne souffre pas. » Et Dieu lui a donné ce qu’il avait demandé.

sw.L: Na Yabesi akamwita Mungu wa Israeli, akisema, "Ikiwa utanibariki kweli kweli, na kupanua mpaka wangu, na mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ukawa pamoja nami, na ukanilinda na madhara, yasije yakaniumiza!" Na Mungu akaleta kile alichoomba.
sw.B: Yabesi alimwomba Mungu wa Israeli: "Laiti ungenibariki sana na kupanua mpaka wangu! Laiti mkono {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ungekuwa pamoja nami, nawe ukanilinda na madhara, yasije yakaniumiza!" Naye Mungu akampa kile alichoomba.
sw.R: Yabesi aliomba kwa Mungu wa Israeli. Alisema, "Tafadhali unibariki sana na unipe nchi zaidi. Uwe pamoja nami na unisaidie. Unilinde na madhara, ili yasiniletee maumivu." Naye Mungu akampa kile alichoomba.

vi.L: Và Gia-bê kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, rằng: "Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật sẽ ban phước cho con, và mở rộng bờ cõi của con, và tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở cùng con, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gìn giữ [con] khỏi tai họa, để nó không làm con đau đớn!" Và Đức Chúa Trời làm thành điều ông đã cầu xin.
vi.B: Gia-bê kêu cầu Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên: "Ước gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban phước dồi dào cho con và mở rộng bờ cõi của con! Ước gì tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở cùng con, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gìn giữ con khỏi tai họa, để con khỏi phải đau đớn!" Và Đức Chúa Trời ban cho ông điều ông đã cầu xin.
vi.R: Gia-bê cầu nguyện với Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ông thưa: "Xin ban phước dồi dào cho con và cho con thêm đất đai. Xin ở cùng con và giúp đỡ con. Xin gìn giữ con khỏi tai họa, để con không phải chịu đau đớn." Và Đức Chúa Trời ban cho ông điều ông cầu xin.

ko.L: 그리고 야베스가 이스라엘의 하나님께 부르짖어 말했다. "주께서 참으로 저에게 복을 주시고 제 지경을 넓혀 주시며, 주님의 손이 저와 함께 있어, 저를 해악에서 [지켜] 그것이 저를 아프게 하지 않게 하신다면!" 그리고 하나님께서 그가 구한 것을 이루어 주셨다.
ko.B: 야베스가 이스라엘의 하나님께 부르짖었다. "주께서 저에게 넘치도록 복을 주시고 제 지경을 넓혀 주신다면 얼마나 좋겠습니까! 주님의 손이 저와 함께하셔서 저를 해악에서 지켜 주시고, 제가 고통을 겪지 않게 해 주신다면 얼마나 좋겠습니까!" 그러자 하나님께서 그가 구한 것을 주셨다.
ko.R: 야베스는 이스라엘의 하나님께 기도했다. "저에게 큰 복을 주시고, 저에게 땅을 더 주십시오. 저와 함께 계시며 저를 도와주십시오. 저를 해로운 일에서 지켜 주셔서, 제가 고통을 겪지 않게 해 주십시오." 그러자 하나님께서 그가 구한 것을 주셨다.

pt.L: E Jabez clamou ao Deus de Israel, dizendo: "Se {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} de fato me abençoares, e alargares o meu território, e a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão estiver comigo, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} [me] guardares do mal, para que não me cause dor!" E Deus fez acontecer o que ele tinha pedido.
pt.B: Jabez invocou o Deus de Israel: "Ah, se {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me abençoasses ricamente e alargasses o meu território! Se a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} mão estivesse comigo, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me guardasses do mal, para que ele não me causasse dor!" E Deus lhe concedeu o que ele tinha pedido.
pt.R: Jabez orou ao Deus de Israel. Ele disse: "Por favor, abençoa-me muito e dá-me mais terra. Fica comigo e ajuda-me. Guarda-me do mal, para que nada me cause dor." E Deus lhe deu o que ele pediu.

decisions.choice: If you will bless me ...: a wish, with no "then" clause
alternatives: a vow whose promise is left unspoken
decisions.reason: The prayer is built like an oath or vow, "If you will ...", but no conclusion follows. The form is used for an earnest wish ("if only"). It may also be a vow whose promise is left unspoken, as in Jacob's vow at Genesis 28:20-22. The doubled verb, "blessing you will bless", makes the request strong.

decisions.choice: enlarge my border: give me more land
decisions.reason: "Border" is the boundary of a person's or tribe's land, and so the land itself. To enlarge it is to give more territory, as God promised Israel (Exodus 34:24; Deuteronomy 12:20). In a chapter about clans and their towns, Jabez asks for room for his family to live.

decisions.choice: your hand be with me: your power help and protect me
decisions.reason: The hand stands for power. For someone's hand to be "with" a person means to give them support (2 Samuel 3:12).

decisions.choice: keep from harm, so that it might not pain me: an echo of his name
decisions.reason: The verb "pain" ('atsav) comes from the same word family as the "pain" in his mother's words (verse 9). Jabez asks that the pain marked in his name will not shape his life; and God grants the request.

decisions.choice: If only
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the Hebrew "if" as "If only", which in English carries the sense of a wish. Literal keeps "If" and ends with an exclamation mark, since the conclusion is never spoken.

decisions.choice: give me more land; Be with me and help me; Keep me safe
decisions.reason: Readable explains "border" and "your hand with me" in plain words and turns the wishes into requests.

decisions.choice: "¡Si ...!" (L); "¡Ojalá ...!" (B); requests in the imperative (R)
decisions.reason: The prayer is an "if" with no "then" clause, an earnest wish (m1). Literal keeps "Si" with an exclamation; Balanced says "Ojalá", the Spanish word for a wish; Readable turns the wishes into requests, as the English does. The deity_pronoun span is on the written "tu"; verb endings carry no span.

decisions.choice: "Si seulement ..." with the imparfait
decisions.reason: French expresses an open wish with "si seulement" and the imparfait, as the English "If only"; the Hebrew has no "then" clause (m1).

decisions.choice: "pour que je ne souffre pas"
alternatives: "pour que la douleur ne m'atteigne pas"
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the link with the pain of verse 9, where the name Yabets is explained (m4).

decisions.choice: Laiti ... ! (a wish)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "if" has no "then" clause; it is a wish, which Swahili says with "laiti". Literal keeps "Ikiwa" (if) and ends with an exclamation mark.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun span on "wako" in "mkono wako" only
decisions.reason: Swahili marks "you" in the verbs (utanibariki, ukanilinda), where no capital can stand, so only the free possessive takes the deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: Jabez says "con" for himself and "Ngài" for God
decisions.reason: The prayer form of the Vietnamese Old Testament: a person praying calls himself "con" and God "Ngài" (with the deity_pronoun span) or "Chúa". Readable uses "Xin ...", the plain way to ask God.

decisions.choice: "Ước gì" for the "if" of an earnest wish
decisions.reason: The "if" clause has no "then"; Balanced makes it a wish, as the English "If only" does.

decisions.choice: prayer in 합쇼체 with "주께서", "주님의" and "저", no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: As in the Korean Psalms, the one praying speaks to God in 합쇼체, calling God "주님" and himself "저"; Korean has no capitals, so the English "you/You" span has no Korean counterpart.

decisions.choice: "...주신다면 얼마나 좋겠습니까!" for "If only"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "if" has no "then" clause (m1); Balanced says it as a wish in Korean, as the English "If only" does, and Literal keeps the bare "if" clause with an exclamation mark.

decisions.choice: tu (Jabez to God), with deity_pronoun spans on "tu" and "tua"; Se ... (L); Ah, se ... (B); Por favor ... (R)
decisions.reason: Jabez speaks to God, so every level uses "tu" (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 4). The prayer is a wish with no "then" clause (m1): Literal keeps the bare "Se" with the future subjunctive and ends with an exclamation mark, as the English does; Balanced says "Ah, se" with the imperfect subjunctive, the Portuguese way of voicing an earnest wish; Readable turns the wishes into requests with the "tu" imperative ("abençoa-me", "dá-me", "guarda-me"). Readable has no pronoun for God to carry a span, as in the English.

decisions.choice: o meu território (L, B), mais terra (R); para que não me cause dor
decisions.reason: The "border" is the land inside it (m2); "território" says that at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says "mais terra", as the English Readable says "more land". The last words keep "dor", the word of verse 9, since the verb echoes his name (m4).

decisions.choice: Chelub the brother of Shuhah: a man known by his brother
decisions.reason: This Chelub is told apart from others by naming his brother, so he is probably not the Chelubai (Caleb) of 2:9. How his family joins the rest of Judah is not said. Eshton here is a person, since he has sons in verse 12, so "father" has its ordinary sense.

decisions.choice: had a son named Mehir. Mehir was
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the chain of names into two short sentences.

ko.B: 에스돈은 벧라바와 바세아와 이르나하스의 아버지 드힌나를 낳았다. 이들이 레가 사람들이었다.
ko.R: 에스돈은 벧라바, 바세아, 드힌나를 낳았다. 드힌나는 이르나하스를 세운 사람이다. 이들이 레가 사람들이었다.

pt.R: Estom foi o pai de Bete-Rafa, Paseia e Teína. Teína foi o fundador de Ir-Naás. Esses foram os homens de Reca.

decisions.choice: Beth-rapha and Ir-nahash: clan and town names
decisions.reason: Beth-rapha means "house of Rapha" and Ir-nahash "town of Nahash"; both look like names of places or family groups counted in the line of Eshton. Neither place is known.

decisions.choice: the men of Recah: an unknown place or group
decisions.reason: Recah is not named anywhere else. The ancient Greek translation reads "Rechab" here.

decisions.choice: founder
decisions.reason: As at verse 3.

ko.L: 그리고 그나스의 아들들은 옷니엘과 스라야이다. 그리고 옷니엘의 아들들은 하닷이다.

ko.R: 그나스의 아들들은 옷니엘과 스라야였다. 옷니엘의 아들 가운데는 하닷이 있었다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Quenaz: Otniel e Seraías. E os filhos de Otniel: Hatate.
pt.B: Os filhos de Quenaz: Otniel e Seraías. Os filhos de Otniel: Hatate.
pt.R: Os filhos de Quenaz foram Otniel e Seraías. Entre os filhos de Otniel estava Hatate.

decisions.choice: Othniel son of Kenaz: the first judge of Israel
decisions.reason: Othniel captured Kiriath-sepher and married Caleb's daughter Achsah (Joshua 15:16-17; Judges 1:12-13), and later rescued Israel as the first of the judges (Judges 3:9-11). Kenaz's family is linked with Caleb, who is called "the Kenizzite" (Numbers 32:12).

decisions.choice: the sons of Othniel: Hathath, and perhaps Meonothai
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "sons" but gives one name. The ancient Greek translation adds "and Meonothai", the name that begins the next verse, so a name may have dropped out in copying.

decisions.choice: included
decisions.reason: Readable says "included" since only one name follows the plural "sons" (see the text note).

decisions.choice: Otniel, Quenaz
decisions.reason: The first judge (m1) keeps the forms of Joshua 15:17 and Judges 1:13 in Portuguese. Readable says "Entre os filhos ... estava", since only one name follows the plural (m2), as the English says "included".

records.literal_gloss: And Meonothai begot Ophrah; and Seraiah begot Joab [the] father of Ge-harashim, for craftsmen they were.

en.L: And Meonothai begot Ophrah, and Seraiah begot Joab, [the] father of Ge-harashim, for they were craftsmen.
en.B: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of Ge-harashim, the Valley of Craftsmen, for its people were craftsmen.
en.R: Meonothai was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, the founder of Ge-harashim. Its name means Valley of Craftsmen, because the people there were skilled workers.

es.L: Y Meonotai engendró a Ofra, y Seraías engendró a Joab, [el] padre de Ge-harasim, porque eran artesanos.
es.B: Meonotai fue padre de Ofra. Seraías fue padre de Joab, padre de Ge-harasim, el valle de los Artesanos, porque su gente era artesana.
es.R: Meonotai fue padre de Ofra. Seraías fue padre de Joab, el fundador de Ge-harasim. Ese nombre significa «valle de los Artesanos», porque la gente de allí eran trabajadores hábiles.

fr.L: Et Méonothaï engendra Ophra, et Seraya engendra Joab, père de Gué-Harashim, car ils étaient artisans.
fr.B: Méonothaï fut le père d’Ophra. Seraya fut le père de Joab, père de Gué-Harashim, la vallée des Artisans, car ses habitants étaient artisans.
fr.R: Méonothaï a eu pour fils Ophra. Seraya a eu pour fils Joab, le fondateur de Gué-Harashim. Ce nom veut dire « vallée des Artisans », parce que les gens de cet endroit étaient des ouvriers habiles.

sw.L: Na Meonothai alimzaa Ofra, na Seraya alimzaa Yoabu, baba wa Ge-harashimu, kwa maana walikuwa mafundi.
sw.B: Meonothai alikuwa baba wa Ofra. Seraya alikuwa baba wa Yoabu, baba wa Ge-harashimu, yaani Bonde la Mafundi, kwa maana watu wake walikuwa mafundi.
sw.R: Meonothai alikuwa baba wa Ofra. Seraya alikuwa baba wa Yoabu, mwanzilishi wa Ge-harashimu. Jina hilo maana yake ni Bonde la Mafundi, kwa sababu watu wa huko walikuwa mafundi stadi.

vi.L: Và Mê-ô-nô-thai sinh Óp-ra, và Sê-ra-gia sinh Giô-áp, cha của Ghê-Ha-ra-sim, vì họ là thợ thủ công.
vi.B: Mê-ô-nô-thai là cha của Óp-ra. Sê-ra-gia là cha của Giô-áp, cha của Ghê-Ha-ra-sim, tức là Thung Lũng Thợ Thủ Công, vì dân ở đó là thợ thủ công.
vi.R: Mê-ô-nô-thai là cha của Óp-ra. Sê-ra-gia là cha của Giô-áp, người lập ra Ghê-Ha-ra-sim. Tên này nghĩa là Thung Lũng Thợ Thủ Công, vì dân ở đó là những người thợ lành nghề.

ko.L: 그리고 므오노대는 오브라를 낳았다. 그리고 스라야는 게하라심의 아버지 요압을 낳았으니, 그들이 장인들이었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 므오노대는 오브라를 낳았다. 스라야는 요압을 낳았는데, 요압은 '장인들의 골짜기'라는 뜻의 게하라심의 아버지였다. 그곳 사람들이 장인들이었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 므오노대는 오브라를 낳았다. 스라야는 요압을 낳았는데, 요압은 게하라심을 세운 사람이다. 게하라심은 '장인들의 골짜기'라는 뜻이다. 그곳 사람들이 솜씨 좋은 기술자들이었기 때문이다.

pt.L: E Meonotai gerou Ofra, e Seraías gerou Joabe, [o] pai de Ge-Harasim, porque eles eram artesãos.
pt.B: Meonotai foi o pai de Ofra. Seraías foi o pai de Joabe, o pai de Ge-Harasim, o Vale dos Artesãos, pois o seu povo era de artesãos.
pt.R: Meonotai foi o pai de Ofra. Seraías foi o pai de Joabe, o fundador de Ge-Harasim. Esse nome quer dizer Vale dos Artesãos, porque as pessoas de lá eram trabalhadores habilidosos.

decisions.choice: Ge-harashim: "Valley of Craftsmen"
decisions.reason: The name means "valley of craftsmen", and the note "for they were craftsmen" explains it. The word names a skilled worker in wood, stone or metal. After the exile people of Benjamin lived in a valley of this name near Lod and Ono (Nehemiah 11:35).

decisions.choice: Ophrah and Joab: people of this family
decisions.reason: This Ophrah is a person or clan, not one of the towns of that name (Judges 6:11; Joshua 18:23). This Joab is not David's commander.

decisions.choice: the Valley of Craftsmen; its people
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the name, which the Hebrew reader would hear, and say "its people" for the bare "they".

decisions.choice: o Vale dos Artesãos
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the name (m1), as the English does. "Artesão" is the ordinary Brazilian word for a skilled worker in wood, stone or metal; "artífice" is bookish. "Ofra" and "Joabe" keep the forms of Judges 6:11 and 2 Samuel, though these are other people (m2).

ko.L: 그리고 여분네의 아들 갈렙의 아들들은 이루, 엘라와 나암이다. 그리고 엘라의 아들들은 그나스이다.
ko.B: 여분네의 아들 갈렙의 아들들은 이루와 엘라와 나암이었다. 엘라의 아들은 그나스였다.
ko.R: 여분네의 아들 갈렙의 아들들은 이루, 엘라, 나암이었다. 엘라의 자손 가운데는 그나스가 있었다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Calebe, filho de Jefoné: Iru, Elá e Naã. E os filhos de Elá: e Quenaz.
pt.B: Os filhos de Calebe, filho de Jefoné: Iru, Elá e Naã. Os filhos de Elá: Quenaz.
pt.R: Os filhos de Calebe, filho de Jefoné, foram Iru, Elá e Naã. Entre os descendentes de Elá estava Quenaz.

decisions.choice: Caleb son of Jephunneh: the faithful spy
decisions.reason: This is the Caleb who, with Joshua, trusted the LORD after spying out the land (Numbers 13:6; 14:6-9, 24) and later received Hebron (Joshua 14:6-14). He is called "the Kenizzite" (Numbers 32:12), which fits his family's link with Kenaz in verses 13 and 15. He is a different man from Caleb son of Hezron (2:18).

decisions.choice: and Kenaz: a name may be missing before it
alternatives: the sons of Elah: [a lost name] and Kenaz
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "the sons of Elah: and Kenaz". The "and" suggests that a name before Kenaz has dropped out, or it may mean "namely". Either way Kenaz is counted among Elah's descendants.

decisions.choice: Kenaz (without "and")
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable leave out the stray "and"; Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: Calebe, filho de Jefoné
decisions.reason: The faithful spy (m1) keeps the Portuguese of Numbers 34:19 and Joshua 15:13.

decisions.choice: Jehallelel: a family whose link is not given
decisions.reason: The list does not say how Jehallelel is related to the families before. Ziph is also the name of towns of Judah (Joshua 15:24, 55), one of them near the wilderness where David hid (1 Samuel 23:14); the clan may have given its name to the place.

en.B: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher and Jalon. She conceived Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
en.R: Ezrah's sons were Jether, Mered, Epher and Jalon. She gave birth to Miriam, Shammai and Ishbah. Ishbah was the founder of Eshtemoa.

fr.B: Les fils d’Ezra : Yéther, Méred, Épher et Yalôn. Elle conçut Myriam, Shammaï, et Yishbah, père d’Eshtemoa.
fr.R: Ezra a eu pour fils Yéther, Méred, Épher et Yalôn. Elle a mis au monde Myriam, Shammaï et Yishbah. Yishbah a été le fondateur d’Eshtemoa.

sw.L: Na mwana wa Ezra: Yetheri, na Meredi, na Eferi, na Yaloni. Naye akapata mimba ya Miriamu, na Shamai, na Ishba baba wa Eshtemoa.
sw.B: Wana wa Ezra: Yetheri, Meredi, Eferi na Yaloni. Naye akapata mimba akawazaa Miriamu, Shamai, na Ishba baba wa Eshtemoa.
sw.R: Wana wa Ezra walikuwa Yetheri, Meredi, Eferi na Yaloni. Mke mmoja aliwazaa Miriamu, Shamai na Ishba. Ishba alikuwa mwanzilishi wa Eshtemoa.

vi.R: Các con trai của Ê-xơ-ra là Giê-the, Mê-rết, Ê-phe và Gia-lôn. Bà sinh Mi-ri-am, Sam-mai và Dít-ba. Dít-ba là người lập ra thành Ếch-tê-mô-a.

ko.L: 그리고 에스라의 아들은 예델과 메렛과 에벨과 얄론이다. 그리고 그녀가 미리암과 삼매와 에스드모아의 아버지 이스바를 임신했다.
ko.B: 에스라의 아들들은 예델과 메렛과 에벨과 얄론이었다. 그녀는 미리암과 삼매와 에스드모아의 아버지 이스바를 임신하여 낳았다.
ko.R: 에스라의 아들들은 예델, 메렛, 에벨, 얄론이었다. 그녀는 미리암, 삼매, 이스바를 낳았다. 이스바는 에스드모아를 세운 사람이다.

pt.L: E o filho de Ezra: Jéter, e Merede, e Éfer, e Jalom. E ela concebeu Miriã, e Samai, e Isbá, [o] pai de Estemoa.
pt.B: Os filhos de Ezra: Jéter, Merede, Éfer e Jalom. Ela concebeu Miriã, Samai e Isbá, o pai de Estemoa.
pt.R: Os filhos de Ezra foram Jéter, Merede, Éfer e Jalom. Ela deu à luz Miriã, Samai e Isbá. Isbá foi o fundador de Estemoa.

decisions.choice: son of Ezrah: the sons of Ezrah
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "son" in the singular before a list of four names; the singular is used for the whole group, as elsewhere in these lists.

decisions.choice: she conceived: the mother is not named here
alternatives: a wife of Jether, the first-named son
decisions.reason: No woman has been mentioned for "she" to refer to. The last sentence of verse 18 names Bithiah, Pharaoh's daughter, whom Mered married, and many read that sentence as belonging before "she conceived", so that Bithiah is the mother of Miriam, Shammai and Ishbah. The text may have been rearranged in copying. Miriam here seems to be a son.

decisions.choice: Eshtemoa: a town in Judah's hill country
decisions.reason: Eshtemoa lay south of Hebron. It was given to the Levites (Joshua 21:14) and was one of the towns to which David sent spoil (1 Samuel 30:28).

decisions.choice: gave birth to; founder
decisions.reason: Readable says "gave birth to" for "conceived", and "founder" as at verse 3.

decisions.choice: Mke mmoja (one wife) for "she"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "she conceived" leaves the mother unnamed (the meaning note: probably Bithiah of verse 18). Swahili verbs do not show gender, so Readable says "one wife" to make clear that a mother is meant.

decisions.choice: Miriã; Estemoa; Ezra
decisions.reason: Miriam keeps the form of the Pentateuch, though she is another woman, and Eshtemoa the form of Joshua 21:14 and 1 Samuel 30:28. Ezrah is "Ezra", the plain Brazilian form of the name.

records.literal_gloss: And his wife the Judean bore Jered [the] father of Gedor, and Heber [the] father of Soco, and Jekuthiel [the] father of Zanoah; and these [are the] sons of Bithiah daughter of Pharaoh, whom took Mered.

en.L: And his wife, the Judean, bore Jered [the] father of Gedor, and Heber [the] father of Soco, and Jekuthiel [the] father of Zanoah. And these [are the] sons of Bithiah daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
en.B: His Judean wife bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah, Pharaoh's daughter, whom Mered married.
en.R: His wife from Judah gave birth to Jered, Heber and Jekuthiel. Jered was the founder of Gedor, Heber of Soco, and Jekuthiel of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah, the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered had married.

es.L: Y su mujer, la judía, dio a luz a Jered, [el] padre de Gedor, y a Heber, [el] padre de Soco, y a Jecutiel, [el] padre de Zanoa. Y estos [son los] hijos de Bitia, hija del faraón, a la que tomó Mered.
es.B: Su mujer judía dio a luz a Jered, padre de Gedor, a Heber, padre de Soco, y a Jecutiel, padre de Zanoa. Estos son los hijos de Bitia, hija del faraón, con la que se casó Mered.
es.R: Su esposa de Judá dio a luz a Jered, Heber y Jecutiel. Jered fue el fundador de Gedor; Heber, de Soco; y Jecutiel, de Zanoa. Estos son los hijos de Bitia, la hija del faraón, con la que se había casado Mered.

fr.L: Et sa femme, la Judéenne, enfanta Yéred, père de Guedor, et Héver, père de Soko, et Yeqoutiel, père de Zanoah. Et ceux-ci [sont] les fils de Bithia, fille du pharaon, que Méred avait prise.
fr.B: Sa femme judéenne enfanta Yéred, père de Guedor, Héver, père de Soko, et Yeqoutiel, père de Zanoah. Ce sont les fils de Bithia, fille du pharaon, que Méred avait épousée.
fr.R: Sa femme, qui venait de Juda, a mis au monde Yéred, Héver et Yeqoutiel. Yéred a été le fondateur de Guedor, Héver celui de Soko, et Yeqoutiel celui de Zanoah. Voici les fils de Bithia, la fille du pharaon, que Méred avait épousée.

sw.L: Na mke wake, Myahudi, alimzaa Yeredi baba wa Gedori, na Heberi baba wa Soko, na Yekuthieli baba wa Zanoa. Na hawa [ndio] wana wa Bithia binti Farao, ambaye Meredi alimtwaa.
sw.B: Mke wake Myahudi alimzaa Yeredi baba wa Gedori, Heberi baba wa Soko, na Yekuthieli baba wa Zanoa. Hao ndio wana wa Bithia, binti Farao, ambaye Meredi alimwoa.
sw.R: Mke wake kutoka Yuda aliwazaa Yeredi, Heberi na Yekuthieli. Yeredi alikuwa mwanzilishi wa Gedori, Heberi wa Soko, na Yekuthieli wa Zanoa. Hao ndio wana wa Bithia, binti Farao, ambaye Meredi alikuwa amemwoa.

vi.L: Và vợ ông, người Giu-đa, sinh Giê-rết cha của Ghê-đô, Hê-be cha của Sô-cô, và Giê-cu-thi-ên cha của Xa-nô-a. Và đây [là] các con trai của Bi-thia con gái Pha-ra-ôn, người mà Mê-rết đã lấy.
vi.B: Người vợ Giu-đa của ông sinh Giê-rết, cha của Ghê-đô, Hê-be, cha của Sô-cô, và Giê-cu-thi-ên, cha của Xa-nô-a. Đây là các con trai của Bi-thia, con gái Pha-ra-ôn, người mà Mê-rết đã cưới.
vi.R: Người vợ quê ở Giu-đa của ông sinh Giê-rết, Hê-be và Giê-cu-thi-ên. Giê-rết là người lập ra thành Ghê-đô, Hê-be lập ra thành Sô-cô, và Giê-cu-thi-ên lập ra thành Xa-nô-a. Đây là các con trai của Bi-thia, con gái của Pha-ra-ôn, người mà Mê-rết đã cưới.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 아내 유다 여자는 그돌의 아버지 예렛과 소고의 아버지 헤벨과 사노아의 아버지 여구디엘을 낳았다. 그리고 이들은 메렛이 맞아들인 바로의 딸 비디아의 아들들이다.
ko.B: 그의 유다 출신 아내는 그돌의 아버지 예렛과 소고의 아버지 헤벨과 사노아의 아버지 여구디엘을 낳았다. 이들은 메렛과 결혼한 바로의 딸 비디아의 아들들이다.
ko.R: 그의 아내인 유다 여자는 예렛과 헤벨과 여구디엘을 낳았다. 예렛은 그돌을 세웠고, 헤벨은 소고를, 여구디엘은 사노아를 세웠다. 앞에 나온 이들은 메렛과 결혼한 바로의 딸 비디아의 아들들이다.

pt.L: E a sua mulher, a judia, deu à luz Jerede, [o] pai de Gedor, e Héber, [o] pai de Socó, e Jecutiel, [o] pai de Zanoa. E estes [são os] filhos de Bitia, filha de Faraó, que Merede tomou.
pt.B: A sua mulher judia deu à luz Jerede, o pai de Gedor, Héber, o pai de Socó, e Jecutiel, o pai de Zanoa. Esses são os filhos de Bitia, filha de Faraó, com quem Merede se casou.
pt.R: A mulher dele, que era de Judá, deu à luz Jerede, Héber e Jecutiel. Jerede foi o fundador de Gedor, Héber o de Socó, e Jecutiel o de Zanoa. Esses são os filhos de Bitia, filha de Faraó, com quem Merede tinha se casado.

decisions.choice: his wife, the Judean: Mered's wife from Judah
decisions.reason: "His" refers to Mered (verse 17, named again at the end of this verse). Calling her "the Judean" sets her apart from his other wife, the Egyptian Bithiah.

decisions.choice: Bithiah daughter of Pharaoh: an Egyptian princess married into Judah
decisions.reason: The name Bithiah may mean "daughter of Yah", perhaps given when she joined Israel. Which Pharaoh was her father is not said. Marriages between Egypt's royal house and Israel's families are known from elsewhere (1 Kings 3:1).

decisions.choice: these are the sons of Bithiah: probably Miriam, Shammai and Ishbah
decisions.reason: The three sons just named were born to the Judean wife, so "these" most likely points back to the children of verse 17 (see the note there).

decisions.choice: Gedor, Soco and Zanoah: towns of Judah
decisions.reason: All three are listed among Judah's towns (Joshua 15:34, 35, 58). Soco is where the Philistines camped before Goliath fought (1 Samuel 17:1).

decisions.choice: married
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "took" a woman means to marry her; Literal keeps "took". Readable also says "founder", as at verse 3, and names the three sons first.

decisions.choice: Héver
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is the one the French Genesis 46:17 writes "Héver"; "Héber" is kept for Eber, Abraham's ancestor (1:18), whose name is different in Hebrew.

decisions.choice: a judia (L), judia (B), que era de Judá (R); filha de Faraó
decisions.reason: "Judia" is the Portuguese word for a woman of Judah (m1), as the English says "the Judean"; Readable says "de Judá", as the English Readable does. "Faraó" without the article, as a name, where the English says "Pharaoh" without one (docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md). Gedor, Socó and Zanoa keep the forms of Joshua 15:34-35, 58 (m4).

en.R: The sons of Hodiah's wife, the sister of Naham, were the founder of Keilah, from the Garmite clan, and Eshtemoa, from the Maacathite clan.

es.R: Los hijos de la esposa de Hodías, la hermana de Naham, fueron el fundador de Keila, del clan garmita, y Estemoa, del clan maacateo.

fr.B: Les fils de la femme de Hodiya, sœur de Naham, furent le père de Qeïla le Garmite et Eshtemoa le Maakatite.
fr.R: Les fils de la femme de Hodiya, la sœur de Naham, ont été le fondateur de Qeïla, du clan des Garmites, et Eshtemoa, du clan des Maakatites.

vi.B: Các con trai của vợ Hô-đia, em gái của Na-ham, là cha của Kê-i-la người Gạc-mít, và Ếch-tê-mô-a người Ma-a-ca.
vi.R: Các con trai của vợ Hô-đia, em gái của Na-ham, là người lập ra thành Kê-i-la, thuộc gia tộc Gạc-mít, và Ếch-tê-mô-a, thuộc gia tộc Ma-a-ca.

ko.L: 그리고 나함의 누이인 호디야의 아내의 아들들은 가미 사람 그일라의 아버지와 마아가 사람 에스드모아이다.
ko.B: 나함의 누이인 호디야의 아내의 아들들은 가미 사람 그일라의 아버지와 마아가 사람 에스드모아였다.
ko.R: 나함의 누이인 호디야의 아내의 아들들은 가미 씨족으로서 그일라를 세운 사람과, 마아가 씨족인 에스드모아였다.

pt.L: E os filhos da mulher de Hodias, [a] irmã de Naão: [o] pai de Queila, o garmita, e Estemoa, o maacatita.
pt.B: Os filhos da mulher de Hodias, a irmã de Naão, foram o pai de Queila, o garmita, e Estemoa, o maacatita.
pt.R: Os filhos da mulher de Hodias, a irmã de Naão, foram o fundador de Queila, do clã dos garmitas, e Estemoa, do clã dos maacatitas.

decisions.choice: the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham
alternatives: his wife Hodiah, the sister of Naham
decisions.reason: The words can be read "the wife of Hodiah", Hodiah being a man (as in Nehemiah 8:7), or "his wife Hodiah", a woman, perhaps the Judean wife of verse 18. "The sister of Naham" describes the wife.

decisions.choice: the father of Keilah: his own name is not given
decisions.reason: The first son is named only by his title. Keilah was a walled town in the low hills, which David rescued from the Philistines (Joshua 15:44; 1 Samuel 23:1-13).

decisions.choice: Garmite, Maacathite: clan names
decisions.reason: "The Garmite" is not known elsewhere. "The Maacathite" may connect this family with Maacah, Caleb's concubine (2:48), or with the people of Maacah in the north (2 Samuel 23:34).

decisions.choice: from the Garmite clan
decisions.reason: Readable explains the clan names with "from the ... clan".

decisions.choice: o garmita, o maacatita (L, B); do clã dos garmitas, dos maacatitas (R)
decisions.reason: The clan names (m3) take "-ita", as "o maacatita" in 2 Samuel 23:34. Queila keeps the form of 1 Samuel 23:1.

decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text and the reading tradition in the margin differ slightly in the spelling of this name; the text followed here takes the reading tradition. The sense is not affected.

decisions.choice: Shimon and Ishi: families whose link is not given
decisions.reason: Neither man is connected to the names before. Ben-zoheth means "son of Zoheth" and may name a grandson. This Ishi is a man of Judah, different from the Ishi of Simeon in verse 42.

en.L: [The] sons of Shelah son of Judah: Er [the] father of Lecah, and Laadah [the] father of Mareshah, and [the] clans of the house of the work of fine linen, of Beth-ashbea,

en.R: The sons of Shelah son of Judah were Er, the founder of Lecah, and Laadah, the founder of Mareshah. Shelah's descendants also included the clans of linen workers at Beth-ashbea.

es.R: Los hijos de Selá hijo de Judá fueron Er, el fundador de Leca, y Laada, el fundador de Maresa. Entre los descendientes de Selá estaban también los clanes de los que trabajaban el lino en Bet-asbea.

ko.L: 유다의 아들 셀라의 아들들은 레가의 아버지 엘과 마레사의 아버지 라아다와 벧아스베아에 있는 세마포 짜는 일을 하는 집의 씨족들과
ko.B: 유다의 아들 셀라의 아들들은 레가의 아버지 엘과 마레사의 아버지 라아다와 벧아스베아에 있는 세마포 짜는 사람들 조합의 씨족들과
ko.R: 유다의 아들 셀라의 아들들은 레가를 세운 엘과 마레사를 세운 라아다였다. 셀라의 자손 가운데는 벧아스베아에서 세마포를 짜는 씨족들도 있었다.

pt.L: Os filhos de Selá, filho de Judá: Er, [o] pai de Leca, e Lada, [o] pai de Maressa, e os clãs da casa da obra do linho fino, de Bete-Asbeia,
pt.B: Os filhos de Selá, filho de Judá: Er, o pai de Leca, Lada, o pai de Maressa, os clãs da corporação dos tecelões de linho em Bete-Asbeia,
pt.R: Os filhos de Selá, filho de Judá, foram Er, o fundador de Leca, e Lada, o fundador de Maressa. Entre os descendentes de Selá estavam também os clãs dos tecelões de linho de Bete-Asbeia.

decisions.choice: Shelah son of Judah, and his son Er
decisions.reason: Shelah was Judah's third son by the daughter of Shua (Genesis 38:5; Numbers 26:20). After the long list of the families of Perez (verses 1-20), the writer turns to Shelah. His son Er carries the name of Shelah's elder brother, who died young (Genesis 38:7).

decisions.choice: the house of the work of fine linen: a guild of weavers
decisions.reason: "House" is used here of a group of families who worked at one trade, the weaving of fine linen. Crafts like this were passed down within clans, as with the potters of verse 23. Beth-ashbea is not known elsewhere.

decisions.choice: Mareshah: a town in the low hills
decisions.reason: Mareshah is in Judah's town list (Joshua 15:44) and was later fortified by Rehoboam (2 Chronicles 11:8). Lecah is not known elsewhere.

decisions.choice: guild of linen workers (Balanced); clans of linen workers (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "guild" for a "house" of workers bound by one trade. The sentence runs on into verse 22, so Literal and Balanced end with a comma. Readable ends the sentence here and goes on in verse 22, and says "founder" as at verse 3.

decisions.choice: la corporation des tisserands de lin (B); les clans des tisserands de lin (R)
alternatives: la maison des ouvriers du lin
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): the "house" of a craft is a guild of weavers (m2); "corporation" is the French word for a guild of one trade.

decisions.choice: chama cha wafumaji wa kitani (a guild of linen weavers)
decisions.reason: "House" here is a body of workers bound by one trade; Balanced says "chama" (guild, association).

decisions.choice: "세마포 짜는 사람들 조합"
decisions.reason: "House of the work of fine linen" is a guild of weavers (m2); Balanced says "조합", as the English says "guild", and Literal keeps "집".

decisions.choice: a corporação dos tecelões de linho (B); os clãs dos tecelões de linho (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "corporação", the Portuguese word for a body of workers in one trade (m2); "guilda" is rare in Brazil. Selá, Er and Maressa keep the forms of Genesis 38:3-5 and Joshua 15:44. The sentence runs on into verse 22 at Literal and Balanced, as in the English.

source.text: וְיוֹקִ֞ים וְאַנְשֵׁ֣י כֹזֵבָ֗א וְיוֹאָ֧שׁ וְשָׂרָ֛ף אֲשֶׁר־בָּעֲל֥וּ לְמוֹאָ֖ב וְיָשֻׁ֣בִי לָ֑חֶם וְהַדְּבָרִ֖ים עַתִּיקִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: and Jokim, and [the] men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who ruled in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem; and the records [are] ancient.

en.L: and Jokim, and [the] men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who ruled in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And the records [are] ancient.
en.B: and Jokim, the men of Cozeba, Joash, and Saraph, who ruled in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. These records are ancient.
en.R: They also included Jokim, the men of Cozeba, Joash and Saraph. Joash and Saraph ruled in Moab. Jashubi-lehem was another of Shelah's descendants. These records come from long ago.

es.L: y Joquim, y [los] hombres de Cozeba, y Joás, y Saraf, que dominaron en Moab, y Jasubi-lehem. Y los registros [son] antiguos.
es.B: y Joquim, los hombres de Cozeba, Joás y Saraf, que dominaron en Moab, y Jasubi-lehem. Estos registros son antiguos.
es.R: También estaban Joquim, los hombres de Cozeba, Joás y Saraf. Joás y Saraf gobernaron en Moab. Jasubi-lehem fue otro de los descendientes de Selá. Estos registros vienen de tiempos muy antiguos.

fr.L: et Yoqim, et les hommes de Kozéba, et Joas, et Saraph, qui dominèrent sur Moab, et Yashoubi-Léhem. Et les choses [sont] anciennes.
fr.B: et Yoqim, les hommes de Kozéba, Joas, et Saraph, qui dominèrent sur Moab, et Yashoubi-Léhem. Ces documents sont anciens.
fr.R: Il y a eu aussi Yoqim, les hommes de Kozéba, Joas et Saraph. Joas et Saraph ont dominé sur Moab. Yashoubi-Léhem était un autre descendant de Shéla. Ces documents datent d’il y a très longtemps.

sw.L: na Yokimu, na watu wa Kozeba, na Yoashi, na Sarafu, waliotawala katika Moabu, na Yashubi-lehemu. Na habari hizi [ni] za kale.
sw.B: na Yokimu, watu wa Kozeba, Yoashi, na Sarafu, waliotawala huko Moabu, na Yashubi-lehemu. Kumbukumbu hizi ni za kale.
sw.R: Walikuwa pia Yokimu, watu wa Kozeba, Yoashi na Sarafu. Yoashi na Sarafu walitawala huko Moabu. Yashubi-lehemu alikuwa pia mmoja wa wazao wa Shela. Kumbukumbu hizi zimetoka zamani sana.

vi.L: và Giô-kim, và những người Cô-xê-ba, và Giô-ách, và Sa-ráp, là những người đã cai trị tại Mô-áp, và Gia-su-bi-Lê-hem. Và các sự việc [này là] xưa.
vi.B: và Giô-kim, những người Cô-xê-ba, Giô-ách và Sa-ráp, là những người đã cai trị tại Mô-áp, và Gia-su-bi-Lê-hem. Những ghi chép này có từ xưa.
vi.R: Họ cũng gồm có Giô-kim, những người Cô-xê-ba, Giô-ách và Sa-ráp. Giô-ách và Sa-ráp cai trị tại Mô-áp. Gia-su-bi-Lê-hem cũng là con cháu của Sê-la. Những ghi chép này có từ rất lâu đời.

ko.L: 요김과 고세바 사람들과 요아스와 모압에서 다스린 사랍과 야수비레헴이다. 그리고 그 기록들은 옛것이다.
ko.B: 요김과 고세바 사람들과 요아스와 모압에서 다스린 사랍과 야수비레헴이었다. 이것은 옛날 기록이다.
ko.R: 또 요김과 고세바 사람들과 요아스와 사랍도 있었다. 요아스와 사랍은 모압에서 다스렸다. 야수비레헴도 셀라의 자손이었다. 이 기록들은 아주 오래전에 전해진 것이다.

pt.L: e Joquim, e os homens de Cozeba, e Joás, e Sarafe, que dominaram em Moabe, e Jasubi-Leém. E os registros [são] antigos.
pt.B: e Joquim, os homens de Cozeba, Joás e Sarafe, que governaram em Moabe, e Jasubi-Leém. Esses registros são antigos.
pt.R: Eles incluíam também Joquim, os homens de Cozeba, Joás e Sarafe. Joás e Sarafe governaram em Moabe. Jasubi-Leém foi outro dos descendentes de Selá. Esses registros vêm de muito tempo atrás.

decisions.choice: ruled in Moab
decisions.reason: The verb means to be lord or master over. It is also used of a man taking a wife, so the phrase could mean that these men married into Moab, as Mahlon and Chilion did (Ruth 1:4).

decisions.choice: Jashubi-lehem: another name in the list
alternatives: a place: who ruled in Moab and Jashubi-lehem
decisions.reason: Jashubi-lehem is read as one more of Shelah's descendants. It could also be a place where Joash and Saraph ruled, or, with different vowels, the words can be read "and they returned to Lehem" (perhaps Bethlehem), as some ancient interpreters understood them.

decisions.choice: the records are ancient
decisions.reason: The word means "words" or "matters". The note seems to tell the reader that these family records come from very old sources, or that the events they record happened long ago.

decisions.choice: Joash and Saraph ruled in Moab. Jashubi-lehem was another
decisions.reason: Readable splits the list into short sentences, naming who ruled in Moab and adding "another of Shelah's descendants" to connect the last name, following the reading taken in the meaning note.

source.text: הֵ֚מָּה הַיּ֣וֹצְרִ֔ים וְיֹשְׁבֵ֥י נְטָעִ֖ים וּגְדֵרָ֑ה עִם־הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ בִּמְלַאכְתּ֖וֹ יָ֥שְׁבוּ שָֽׁם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: They [were] the potters and [the] inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; with the king in his work they dwelt there.

en.L: They [were] the potters and [the] inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; with the king, in his work, they dwelt there.
en.B: They were potters, and they lived in Netaim and Gederah; they made their home there with the king, working for him.
en.R: These people were potters. They lived in Netaim and Gederah and worked there for the king.

es.L: Ellos [eran] los alfareros y [los] habitantes de Netaim y Gedera; con el rey, en su trabajo, habitaban allí.
es.B: Eran alfareros, y vivían en Netaim y Gedera; allí se establecieron con el rey, trabajando para él.
es.R: Esta gente era alfarera. Vivían en Netaim y Gedera, y allí trabajaban para el rey.

fr.L: Ils [étaient] les potiers et les habitants de Netaïm et de Guedéra ; auprès du roi, dans son travail, ils habitaient là.
fr.B: C’étaient des potiers, qui habitaient à Netaïm et à Guedéra ; ils s’y étaient établis auprès du roi, pour travailler à son service.
fr.R: Ces gens étaient des potiers. Ils habitaient à Netaïm et à Guedéra, et ils travaillaient là pour le roi.

sw.L: Hao [walikuwa] wafinyanzi na wakazi wa Netaimu na Gedera; pamoja na mfalme katika kazi yake walikaa huko.
sw.B: Hao walikuwa wafinyanzi, nao waliishi Netaimu na Gedera; walikaa huko pamoja na mfalme, wakimfanyia kazi.
sw.R: Watu hao walikuwa wafinyanzi. Waliishi Netaimu na Gedera, wakamfanyia mfalme kazi huko.

vi.L: Họ [là] những thợ gốm và dân cư của Nê-ta-im và Ghê-đê-ra; với vua, trong công việc của vua, họ ở tại đó.
vi.B: Họ là những thợ gốm và sống tại Nê-ta-im và Ghê-đê-ra; họ ở đó với vua và làm việc cho vua.
vi.R: Những người này là thợ gốm. Họ sống tại Nê-ta-im và Ghê-đê-ra và làm việc tại đó cho vua.

ko.L: 그들은 토기장이들이며 느다임과 그데라의 주민들이다. 왕과 함께 그의 일을 하며 그들이 거기에서 살았다.
ko.B: 그들은 토기장이들로서 느다임과 그데라에 살았다. 그들은 그곳에서 왕과 함께 살며 왕의 일을 했다.
ko.R: 이 사람들은 토기장이였다. 그들은 느다임과 그데라에 살면서 그곳에서 왕을 위해 일했다.

pt.L: Eles [eram] os oleiros e os moradores de Netaim e Gedera; com o rei, no seu trabalho, habitaram ali.
pt.B: Eles eram oleiros e moravam em Netaim e Gedera; tinham ali a sua casa junto ao rei, trabalhando para ele.
pt.R: Essas pessoas eram oleiros. Moravam em Netaim e Gedera e ali trabalhavam para o rei.

decisions.choice: with the king in his work: royal craftsmen
decisions.reason: The potters lived on royal land and made pottery for the king. Jar handles stamped "belonging to the king" have been found in Judah, showing that royal workshops supplied the kingdom. Which king is meant is not said.

decisions.choice: Netaim and Gederah: place names
decisions.reason: Netaim means "plantings" and Gederah "walls" or "pens". Gederah was a town in the low hills (Joshua 15:36); Netaim is not known. The words could also be read as "those who live among plantings and walls".

decisions.choice: potters, and they lived in
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable treat "potters" and "inhabitants" as the same people, and say "lived in" for "inhabitants of".

decisions.choice: os oleiros (L), oleiros (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Oleiro" is the Bible's word for a potter (Jeremiah 18) and the ordinary Portuguese one for a man who makes clay pots; "ceramista" sounds like an artist. They worked for the king on royal land (m1). Gedera keeps the form of Joshua 15:36.

records.literal_gloss: [The] sons of Simeon: Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul.

en.R: Simeon's sons were Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah and Shaul.

es.B: Los hijos de Simeón: Nemuel, Jamín, Jarib, Zera y Saúl.
es.R: Los hijos de Simeón fueron Nemuel, Jamín, Jarib, Zera y Saúl.

fr.L: Les fils de Siméon : Nemouel, et Jamin, Yarib, Zérah, Shaoul.
fr.B: Les fils de Siméon : Nemouel, Jamin, Yarib, Zérah et Shaoul.
fr.R: Siméon a eu pour fils Nemouel, Jamin, Yarib, Zérah et Shaoul.

sw.L: Wana wa Simeoni: Nemueli, na Yamini, Yaribu, Zera, Shauli.
sw.B: Wana wa Simeoni: Nemueli, Yamini, Yaribu, Zera na Shauli.
sw.R: Wana wa Simeoni walikuwa Nemueli, Yamini, Yaribu, Zera na Shauli.

vi.L: Các con trai của Si-mê-ôn: Nê-mu-ên, Gia-min, Gia-ríp, Xê-rách, Sau-lơ.
vi.B: Các con trai của Si-mê-ôn là Nê-mu-ên, Gia-min, Gia-ríp, Xê-rách và Sau-lơ.
vi.R: Các con trai của Si-mê-ôn là Nê-mu-ên, Gia-min, Gia-ríp, Xê-rách và Sau-lơ.

ko.L: 시므온의 아들들은 느무엘과 야민, 야립, 세라, 사울이다.
ko.B: 시므온의 아들들은 느무엘과 야민과 야립과 세라와 사울이었다.
ko.R: 시므온의 아들들은 느무엘, 야민, 야립, 세라, 사울이었다.

pt.L: Os filhos de Simeão: Nemuel, e Jamim, Jaribe, Zerá, Saul.
pt.B: Os filhos de Simeão: Nemuel, Jamim, Jaribe, Zerá e Saul.
pt.R: Os filhos de Simeão foram Nemuel, Jamim, Jaribe, Zerá e Saul.

decisions.choice: Simeon's sons, as in Numbers 26:12-13 with one change
decisions.reason: Genesis 46:10 and Exodus 6:15 list Jemuel, Jamin, Ohad, Jachin, Zohar and Shaul. This list follows Numbers 26:12-13 in reading Nemuel for Jemuel and Zerah for Zohar and in leaving out Ohad, and it has Jarib where Numbers has Jachin.

decisions.choice: Simeon: a tribe with its towns inside Judah
decisions.reason: Simeon was Jacob's second son. His tribe received towns within the land of Judah (Joshua 19:1-9), which is why the writer places it right after Judah.

decisions.choice: Nemuel, Jamim, Jaribe, Zerá, Saul
decisions.reason: Simeon's sons keep the forms of Numbers 26:12-13 in Portuguese (m1); Jarib, where Numbers has Jachin ("Jaquim"), is "Jaribe".

records.literal_gloss: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.

en.L: Shallum [was] his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
en.B: Shaul's son was Shallum, his son was Mibsam, and his son was Mishma.
en.R: Shaul's son was Shallum. Shallum's son was Mibsam, and Mibsam's son was Mishma.

es.L: Salum [fue] su hijo, Mibsam su hijo, Misma su hijo.
es.B: El hijo de Saúl fue Salum; su hijo, Mibsam; y su hijo, Misma.
es.R: El hijo de Saúl fue Salum. El hijo de Salum fue Mibsam, y el hijo de Mibsam fue Misma.

fr.L: Shalloum son fils, Mibsam son fils, Mishma son fils.
fr.B: Le fils de Shaoul fut Shalloum, son fils fut Mibsam, et son fils fut Mishma.
fr.R: Le fils de Shaoul a été Shalloum. Le fils de Shalloum a été Mibsam, et le fils de Mibsam a été Mishma.

sw.L: Shalumu [alikuwa] mwanawe, Mibsamu mwanawe, Mishma mwanawe.
sw.B: Mwana wa Shauli alikuwa Shalumu, mwanawe alikuwa Mibsamu, na mwanawe alikuwa Mishma.
sw.R: Mwana wa Shauli alikuwa Shalumu. Mwana wa Shalumu alikuwa Mibsamu, na mwana wa Mibsamu alikuwa Mishma.

vi.L: Sa-lum con trai người, Mi-bô-sam con trai người, Mích-ma con trai người.
vi.B: Con trai Sau-lơ là Sa-lum, con trai Sa-lum là Mi-bô-sam, và con trai Mi-bô-sam là Mích-ma.
vi.R: Con trai của Sau-lơ là Sa-lum. Con trai của Sa-lum là Mi-bô-sam, và con trai của Mi-bô-sam là Mích-ma.

ko.L: 그의 아들 살룸, 그의 아들 밉삼, 그의 아들 미스마.
ko.B: 사울의 아들은 살룸이고, 그의 아들은 밉삼, 그의 아들은 미스마였다.
ko.R: 사울의 아들은 살룸이었다. 살룸의 아들은 밉삼이고, 밉삼의 아들은 미스마였다.

pt.L: Salum [foi] o seu filho, Mibsão o seu filho, Misma o seu filho.
pt.B: O filho de Saul foi Salum; o filho deste foi Mibsão, e o filho de Mibsão foi Misma.
pt.R: O filho de Saul foi Salum. O filho de Salum foi Mibsão, e o filho de Mibsão foi Misma.

decisions.choice: his son: each the son of the one before, starting from Shaul
decisions.reason: The first "his" most naturally refers to Shaul, the last name in verse 24, and each later name is the son of the one before it.

decisions.choice: Mibsam and Mishma: names shared with Ishmael's family
decisions.reason: Two sons of Ishmael have the same names (Genesis 25:13-14; 1:29-30). The tribes of the south may have shared names, or families from the desert may have joined Simeon.

decisions.choice: Shaul's
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Shaul so that the reader knows whose son Shallum was.

decisions.choice: Mibsão, Misma
decisions.reason: The two names shared with Ishmael's sons (m2) keep the forms of Genesis 25:13-14 in Portuguese.

source.text: וּבְנֵ֖י מִשְׁמָ֑ע חַמּוּאֵ֥ל בְּנ֛וֹ זַכּ֥וּר בְּנ֖וֹ שִׁמְעִ֥י בְנֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

en.L: And [the] sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
en.B: The descendants of Mishma: his son Hammuel, Hammuel's son Zaccur, and Zaccur's son Shimei.
en.R: Mishma's son was Hammuel. Hammuel's son was Zaccur, and Zaccur's son was Shimei.

es.L: Y [los] hijos de Misma: Hamuel su hijo, Zacur su hijo, Simei su hijo.
es.B: Los descendientes de Misma: su hijo Hamuel, el hijo de Hamuel, Zacur, y el hijo de Zacur, Simei.
es.R: El hijo de Misma fue Hamuel. El hijo de Hamuel fue Zacur, y el hijo de Zacur fue Simei.

fr.L: Et les fils de Mishma : Hammouel son fils, Zakkour son fils, Shiméï son fils.
fr.B: Les descendants de Mishma : son fils Hammouel, Zakkour, le fils de Hammouel, et Shiméï, le fils de Zakkour.
fr.R: Le fils de Mishma a été Hammouel. Le fils de Hammouel a été Zakkour, et le fils de Zakkour a été Shiméï.

sw.L: Na wana wa Mishma: Hamueli mwanawe, Zakuri mwanawe, Shimei mwanawe.
sw.B: Wazao wa Mishma: mwanawe Hamueli, mwana wa Hamueli Zakuri, na mwana wa Zakuri Shimei.
sw.R: Mwana wa Mishma alikuwa Hamueli. Mwana wa Hamueli alikuwa Zakuri, na mwana wa Zakuri alikuwa Shimei.

vi.L: Và các con trai của Mích-ma: Ham-mu-ên con trai người, Xa-cu-rơ con trai người, Si-mê-i con trai người.
vi.B: Con cháu của Mích-ma là Ham-mu-ên con trai ông, Xa-cu-rơ con trai Ham-mu-ên, và Si-mê-i con trai Xa-cu-rơ.
vi.R: Con trai của Mích-ma là Ham-mu-ên. Con trai của Ham-mu-ên là Xa-cu-rơ, và con trai của Xa-cu-rơ là Si-mê-i.

ko.L: 그리고 미스마의 아들들은 그의 아들 함무엘, 그의 아들 삭굴, 그의 아들 시므이이다.
ko.B: 미스마의 자손은 그의 아들 함무엘, 함무엘의 아들 삭굴, 삭굴의 아들 시므이였다.
ko.R: 미스마의 아들은 함무엘이었다. 함무엘의 아들은 삭굴이고, 삭굴의 아들은 시므이였다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Misma: Hamuel, o seu filho, Zacur, o seu filho, Simei, o seu filho.
pt.B: Os descendentes de Misma: o seu filho Hamuel, o filho de Hamuel, Zacur, e o filho de Zacur, Simei.
pt.R: O filho de Misma foi Hamuel. O filho de Hamuel foi Zacur, e o filho de Zacur foi Simei.

decisions.choice: sons of Mishma: a line of descent
decisions.reason: As in verse 25, the list traces one generation after another.

decisions.choice: Hammuel's son; Zaccur's son
decisions.reason: As in verse 25, Balanced and Readable name the father each time.

source.text: וּלְשִׁמְעִ֞י בָּנִ֨ים שִׁשָּׁ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ וּבָנ֣וֹת שֵׁ֔שׁ וּלְאֶחָ֕יו אֵ֖ין בָּנִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְכֹל֙ מִשְׁפַּחְתָּ֔ם לֹ֥א הִרְבּ֖וּ עַד־בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And to Shimei [were] sons sixteen and daughters six, and to his brothers there [were] not sons many, and all their clan did not multiply as far as [the] sons of Judah.

en.L: And to Shimei [were] sixteen sons and six daughters, but to his brothers [there were] not many {{gender:children|sons}}, and all their clan did not multiply as much as the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah.
en.B: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers had few {{gender:children|sons}}, and their whole clan did not become as numerous as the {{gender:people|sons}} of Judah.
en.R: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters. His brothers, though, had only a few {{gender:children|sons}}. So the clans of Simeon never grew as large as the tribe of Judah.

es.L: Y Simei [tuvo] dieciséis hijos y seis hijas, pero sus hermanos no [tuvieron] muchos hijos, y todo su clan no se multiplicó tanto como los hijos de Judá.
es.B: Simei tuvo dieciséis hijos y seis hijas, pero sus hermanos tuvieron pocos hijos, y todo su clan no llegó a ser tan numeroso como el pueblo de Judá.
es.R: Simei tuvo dieciséis hijos y seis hijas. Sus hermanos, en cambio, tuvieron pocos hijos. Por eso los clanes de Simeón nunca llegaron a ser tan grandes como la tribu de Judá.

sw.R: Shimei alikuwa na wana kumi na sita na binti sita. Lakini ndugu zake walikuwa na watoto wachache tu. Kwa hiyo koo za Simeoni hazikuwa kubwa kama kabila la Yuda.

vi.L: Và Si-mê-i có mười sáu con trai và sáu con gái, nhưng các anh em ông không có nhiều con cái, và cả họ hàng của họ cũng không gia tăng như con cháu Giu-đa.

vi.R: Si-mê-i có mười sáu con trai và sáu con gái. Nhưng các anh em ông chỉ có ít con cái. Vì vậy các gia tộc Si-mê-ôn không bao giờ đông bằng chi tộc Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 시므이에게 아들 열여섯과 딸 여섯이 [있었으나], 그의 형제들에게는 자녀가 많지 않았고, 그들의 온 씨족이 유다 자손만큼 불어나지 못했다.
ko.B: 시므이에게는 아들 열여섯과 딸 여섯이 있었으나, 그의 형제들에게는 자녀가 많지 않았다. 그래서 그들의 온 씨족은 유다 자손만큼 많아지지 못했다.
ko.R: 시므이에게는 아들 열여섯과 딸 여섯이 있었다. 그러나 그의 형제들에게는 자녀가 몇 되지 않았다. 그래서 시므온의 씨족들은 유다 지파만큼 커지지 못했다.

pt.R: Simei teve dezesseis filhos e seis filhas. Mas os irmãos dele tiveram poucos filhos. Por isso os clãs de Simeão nunca ficaram tão grandes como a tribo de Judá.

decisions.choice: Simeon did not grow like Judah
decisions.reason: Simeon became one of the smallest tribes: from 59,300 men at the first census (Numbers 1:23) to 22,200 at the second (Numbers 26:14). Its towns lay inside Judah's land (Joshua 19:9), and Jacob had said Simeon would be scattered in Israel (Genesis 49:7).

decisions.choice: "hijos" (no gender setting)

decisions.choice: filhos (no gender setting)
decisions.reason: The English puts "children/sons" under the gender setting, but the Portuguese plural "filhos" already means children of both sexes (m2), as the Old Testament terms note says for "os filhos de Israel"; a span would offer two identical words. For "the sons of Judah" Literal keeps "os filhos de Judá" and Balanced says "o povo de Judá", as 2:10 does; Readable says "a tribo de Judá", as the English Readable does.

decisions.reason: Beersheba was the town at the southern limit of Israel, as in the saying "from Dan to Beersheba" (Judges 20:1). It was linked with Abraham and Isaac (Genesis 21:31; 26:33).

decisions.reason: Joshua 19:5-6 has Hazar-susah, Beth-lebaoth and Sharuhen at these places in the list. Hazar-susim and Hazar-susah are forms of one name; the others may be other names for the same towns.

decisions.choice: until David reigned: these towns later passed to Judah
decisions.reason: From David's time these towns were counted as belonging to Judah and its kings; Ziklag, for example, became the property of the kings of Judah (1 Samuel 27:6). The writer does not say how this happened.

decisions.choice: towns
decisions.reason: As in Joshua 19, Literal says "cities" and Balanced and Readable say "towns", which fits the size of these places.

decisions.reason: The places were small; Balanced and Readable say "poblaciones", as the English says "towns" and the published Deuteronomy says of small places.

decisions.choice: "살았다" at the end of verse 31
decisions.reason: Korean puts the verb last, so "they lived" of verse 28 is said where the list of towns ends; Readable makes the list the subject ("그들이 산 곳은 ...이었다").

decisions.choice: cidades (every level)
decisions.reason: As Joshua 19:6 and 21:2 have it in Portuguese, the towns are "cidades" at every level; the English says "towns" at Balanced and Readable, but Portuguese "cidade" is used of a walled place of any size, and "vila" would be a different, smaller kind of settlement.

decisions.choice: the ones coming by name: those entered in the list by name
decisions.reason: The phrase refers to the names just listed in verses 34-37.

decisions.choice: broke out to abundance: increased greatly
decisions.reason: The verb "break out" is used of a family spreading and growing (Genesis 28:14; 30:30). Their growth explains why they needed more pasture (verse 39).

decisions.choice: ancestral families (Balanced); families (Readable)
decisions.reason: "House of their fathers" is rendered as elsewhere in these books.

decisions.choice: "familias patriarcales" (B); "familias" (R)
decisions.reason: "House of their fathers" is the father's household or clan; Balanced uses "familias patriarcales", as the published Exodus 6:14, and Readable "familias".

decisions.choice: jamaa za baba zao (ancestral families)
decisions.reason: "House of their fathers" is the family group traced through the male line; Balanced says "jamaa za baba zao", Readable "jamaa zao". Literal keeps "nyumba ya baba zao".

decisions.choice: a casa dos seus pais (L); as suas famílias (B, R)
decisions.reason: A father's house is "a família" at Balanced and Readable, and Literal keeps the Hebrew "a casa dos seus pais", as docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md and Exodus 6:14 set it in Portuguese.
